tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "=== INITIAL ==="; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "=== NEW ==="; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "=== COUNTS ==="; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg --help 2>&1; echo "=== CREATE ==="; hops fg create --help 2>&1
tool_input.description: Show fg command and create help

tool_input.command:
hops fg create customers41dcc4 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --features "row_id:string,name:string,balance_eur:double,updated_at:bigint" \
  --description "Customers initial export (original schema)" \
  --if-exists get 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"
hops fg insert customers41dcc4 --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"

hops fg create customers41dcc4 --version 2 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time updated_at \
  --features "row_id:string,full_name:string,balance:double,currency:string,updated_at:bigint" \
  --online \
  --description "Customers full re-export (new schema), online-enabled" \
  --if-exists get 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"
hops fg insert customers41dcc4 --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"

hops fg info customers41dcc4 --version 2 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"; echo "=== FEATURES ==="; hops fg features customers41dcc4 --version 2 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"
hops fg preview customers41dcc4 --version 2 --n 5 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|To ensure\|pip install"
